# `jouet rule pack rm`

- **Usage:** `jouet rule pack rm [--repo] <NAME>`

Unpin a pack

## Arguments
- **`<NAME>`** — The pack's name

## Flags
- **`--repo`** — Unpin it from this repository's .jouet/packs.toml rather than yours
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
